s: I am Maya, and this is my friend Lena.
Today we talk about sports and fitness.
It is a fun day for sports!
A sport is a game like football or tennis.
Lena, what is your favorite sport?
A sport is good for your body.
Sport makes me happy and strong.
A player is a person who plays a sport.
The best player on my tennis team is my friend Sara.
A player needs to run fast.
A good player trains every day.
I want to be a good player one day.
A player works hard and never stops.
Friends, let me tell you about the Muse English app.
It is free, and it helps you learn English every day.
You get new words with photos and clear pronunciation.
You can listen to this podcast in the app.
There are fun shadowing stories, quick quizzes, grammar lessons, and a leaderboard where you earn points.
It is the easy way to practice a little every day.
Search for Muse English and install it today.
Now let us talk about exercise.
Exercise is good for the body.
What exercise do you do, Maya?
Ten minutes of exercise is a good start for the day.
A little exercise every day is great.
Exercise helps you feel good and happy.
A match is a game between two teams.
On Saturday, I watched a football match.
In a match, many players play together.
My favorite match was last year.
In a match, the players run a lot.
A good match has many goals.
The match can be long, but it is always fun.
After the match, the players say goodbye.
A match is a great day with friends.

A trophy is a prize for the winner.
The winning team gets a trophy.
The players were so happy with the trophy.
A trophy is a big dream.
Maybe one day I will win a trophy.
A trophy for the best team.
Friends, remember our five words: match, player, sport, exercise, and trophy.
Exercise is good for the body.
